## What this is about (plain English)
We need a clear how-to guide for the **<API NAME>** API so a developer can go from zero to a working integration without getting stuck.

## What to write
- A short intro: what this API does and when to use it.
- Prerequisites: account, test keys, base URL.
- Step-by-step integration with **copy-paste code** (at least one language — Node or Python preferred).
- How to test it in **test mode**.
- Common errors and how to fix them.
- Links to the full API reference on `docs.spotflow.one` / `docs.hyperrails.io`.

## Done when (acceptance criteria)
- [ ] Guide follows the structure above.
- [ ] Code sample runs in test mode (no real secret keys committed — placeholders only).
- [ ] Links are correct and point to the current docs domain.
- [ ] Reviewed and merged.

## Helpful info
- **API / docs:** <link>
- **Difficulty:** good first issue
- **How to claim:** comment below and a maintainer will assign you.
